description: This file defines the Subunit class, which extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable and ValueXModifiable. It manages filtering logic related to organizational subunits within the OrangeHRM system, including query modifications and data transformations for subunit entities.

classes.name: Subunit
classes.description: Represents a filter field for organizational subunits, providing methods to modify queries and transform subunit data for reporting purposes.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds filtering conditions to the query builder based on the operator and selected subunit(s).

methods.name: getSubunitIds
methods.description: Returns an array of subunit IDs by exploding the comma-separated string from getX().

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias used in queries, here 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the subunit ID to an array with its id and name, or null if not applicable.

methods.name: xValueModifier
methods.description: Modifies the x value by retrieving the chain of subunit IDs and concatenating them into a comma-separated string.
